notes.5: The "Short Spike" is a fluid system in which White has several interesting means of disrupting the black defenses. The obvious threat of g5 discourages development of the black Knight at f6, and any attempt to attack this pawn structure to neutralize the threat has the effect of simultaneously weakening the black defenses.
